subject.title: fix: prioritize exhausted Antigravity quota in menu bar and highest usage

question: Should Antigravity automatic mode intentionally use nearest actionable reset for the menu bar while Overview/highest-usage ranks by maximum quota consumption, even when those consumers show different lanes from the same snapshot?
rationale: Current main’s tests encode different behavior, the PR deliberately introduces context-specific semantics, and neither repository docs nor maintainer discussion establishes which user-facing contract is authoritative.

options.title: Approve context-specific semantics
options.body: Keep reset-focused menu-bar selection and maximum-consumption Overview ranking, then require direct live proof of both outputs from one snapshot.

options.title: Use one consistent lane
options.body: Make automatic display and highest-usage ranking resolve the same binding quota lane to avoid mismatched percentages and reset times.

options.title: Preserve current behavior
options.body: Retain the existing usable-window preference and close this PR unless a narrower exhausted-state display fix is proposed.

recommendation.title: Approve context-specific semantics
recommendation.body: Keep reset-focused menu-bar selection and maximum-consumption Overview ranking, then require direct live proof of both outputs from one snapshot.

likelyOwner.reason: The repository owner was explicitly asked to decide this user-facing metric contract and is the clearest authority for cross-surface display semantics.
